newsitem.title: USA: CRA Managed, Occusystems to merge.
newsitem.headline: CRA Managed, Occusystems to merge.

text.p: CRA Managed Care Inc and and OccuSystems Inc on Monday said they agreed to merge in a tax-free stock-for-stock exchange.
Outstanding shares of both companies will be exchanged for new shares in the new company, Concentra Managed Care.

Each share of OccuSystems will equal 0.56 shares of CRA, the companies said. OccuSystems' 21.6 million shares will be exchanged for 57.3 percent of the combined company, while CRA's nine million shares will be exchanged for 42.7 percent.
CRA shares closed Monday off 1-7/8 at 37-7/8. Those of Occusystems were unchanged at 19-1/8.

Both companies said their boards have approved the merger, which is to be accounted for as a pooling of interests. The deal still requires shareholder approval and applicable waiting periods for federal antitrust review.
The companies said Concentra Managed Care will be headquartered in Boston.
CRA and OccuSystems will each nominate four directors to the board, which will have at least eight members. The company will maintain regional offices in Dallas.

Both companies said they mutually have granted each other an option to buy up to 10 percent of the other's common stock, exercisable if the pact ends under certain circumstances. Both companies also agreed to a termination fee of $10 million.
CRA provides managed care services designed to cut costs associated with workers' compensation, automobile and disability insurance claims.
OccuSystems is a physician practice management company focusing on occupational healthcare.
